text: The agent was tasked with tightening email validation to require a dot in the domain, but along the way it refactored the entire signup validator into separate per-field rule modules with a shared RULES array for easier extensibility, and made an unrelated stylistic tweak to legacy-import.js. The core objective was fixing the email pattern to reject dotless domains; the modularization and legacy code style change were self-initiated scope expansions beyond that fix.
